content.title: Chesapeake Granite Wash: Q3 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: HOUSTON (AP) — Chesapeake Granite Wash Trust (CHKR) on Monday reported earnings of $817,000 in its third quarter. The Houston-based company said it had profit of 2 cents per share. The owner of royalty interests in oil and natural gas properties posted revenue of $1.4 million in the period.

content.title: Chesapeake Granite Wash: Q2 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: HOUSTON (AP) — Chesapeake Granite Wash Trust (CHKR) on Wednesday reported earnings of $1.4 million in its second quarter. On a per-share basis, the Houston-based company said it had net income of 3 cents. The owner of royalty interests in oil and natural gas properties posted revenue of $1.6 million in the period.
